description: This script performs static analysis on TypeScript source files to detect insecure or undesirable references to pairing-store identifiers within group authorization logic. It imports utility functions to parse and traverse TypeScript AST, defines functions to identify specific patterns related to pairing-store identifiers, and reports violations to enforce security constraints related to group-based authorization.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the textual name from a variable or binding pattern node.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Recursively searches an AST node for identifiers or call expressions that match pairing-store related patterns.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Returns the name of a call expression, handling dot-access expressions.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects calls to 'normalizeAllowFromWithStore' with specific arguments referencing pairing store sources.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Analyzes the source code AST to find violations related to pairing-store in group scope variables and properties.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function to collect violations from relevant source files and report findings, enforcing security constraints.
